title: Niagara-on-the-Lake Wine Tour with Tastings
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Embark on an unforgettable winery tour through Niagara Wine Country, rated #1 for a reason! Join us for a fully-guided, educational experience led by an industry expert, as you explore some of the region’s most prestigious wineries and taste world-renowned wines, including some of the rarest Icewine in the world. This is the perfect opportunity to immerse yourself in the beauty of Niagara-on-the-Lake and enjoy a day of wine, relaxation, and discovery.
